Meta published Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-21. The quarter ended 2026-09-30. No pre-earnings Preview exists in the supplied source. A later reconstructed historical article cannot serve as a forecast check.
Revenue was USD 64.601 billion, up 26% year over year. GAAP operating income was USD 12.988 billion. GAAP expenses included a USD 9.89 billion litigation charge. The company also presented a counterfactual: without this charge, operating income would have been USD 22.88 billion. This counterfactual is not a GAAP actual.
Operating cash flow was USD 32.79 billion. Capital expenditure including finance lease principal was USD 34.91 billion. Free cash flow was negative USD 2.12 billion. The negative free cash flow resulted mainly from capex exceeding operating cash flow.
The company guided Q4 2026 revenue to USD 73-76 billion. The company guided 2026 capex to USD 135-145 billion.
The supplied facts do not include segment or product-level profit. Product-level profit remains unverified. The supplied source does not include Q3 guidance, market consensus, or prior-quarter figures. Therefore no target-versus-actual judgment can be made.
For the next report, compare actual revenue with guidance, monitor the capex guidance, and check whether one-off charges affect GAAP operating income again.
